Comment.Language: For the Feast of the Circumcision:

Text.Language: All/louia: All/louia. I/couc Pi,~rictoc p~s/ri m~V] afswp e~rof m~picebi kata petecse qen pinomoc: All/louia: All/louia.
Alleluia, Alleluia. Jesus Christ, the Son of God, accepted unto Him the circumcision, according to what is fitting in the Law. Alleluia, Alleluia.
